tag: 每日掃描 · 擴大文獻查詢範圍
body: 新增 2 則文獻，皆為突觸核蛋白病變的診斷生物標記研究；無試驗異動。①掃描方法調整：本站文獻查詢原僅用「multiple system atrophy」標題檢索，本次改以標題＋摘要並納入 MSA-P／MSA-C 檢索，因而帶出兩筆標題未含 MSA、但內容直接涉及 MSA 鑑別診斷的研究；此二筆為擴大範圍後的回補，逐筆確認確有 MSA 相關內容才收錄。②DaT SPECT 與 α-突觸核蛋白皮膚切片是互補還是重複？（BMJ Neurology Open 8(2):e001759，美國佛羅里達大學 Norman Fixel 研究所 Martinez-Nunez AE 等、資深作者 McFarland NR，doi:10.1136/bmjno-2026-001759，2026/09/03）：回溯 2022/01–2025/03 間表現為帕金森症或顫抖、尚未符合 PD／MSA／DLB 準則的病人，86 人做皮膚切片、其中 52 人另做 DaT SPECT。兩者敏感度相同（均 79.0%）、特異度 74.0% 對 81.0%；合併判讀敏感度升至 95.6%、特異度降至 59.9%；30.8% 的雙檢者結果不一致，DaT 陽性／切片陰性者較常有嗅覺減退，反之較常有 RBD，不一致者近半數最終診斷為原發性帕金森氏症。作者結論為兩者互補而非重複，早期宜作為 rule-in 工具、陰性不能排除。⚠️ 回溯性、單中心、雙檢者僅 52 人；參考標準為臨床診斷而非病理；設計上排除已符合 MSA 準則者，不能直接外推至已確診 MSA 族群，摘要亦未拆分 MSA 次族群。③門診真實世界的 P-SYN 皮膚切片臨床效用（Frontiers in Neurology 17:1868980，Levine T 等、通訊 Gibbons CH，doi:10.3389/fneur.2026.1868980，2026/08/25 線上、2026/09/10 收錄 PubMed）：100 名疑似神經退化疾病門診病人，切片後60% 的 ICD-10 診斷紀錄改變、91% 的治療計畫改變。⚠️ 利益衝突須先看：含第一與通訊作者在內 4 人為皮膚切片檢測廠商 CND Life Sciences 員工、3 人持該公司股票選擇權（作者自陳），屬廠商參與研究；回溯性、單一私人診所、無對照；終點是「診斷與治療計畫有無改變」而非診斷是否正確，無病理或長期追蹤金標準；摘要未拆分 MSA 人數與結果。本日其餘掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 窗內無新的 MSA 試驗、亦無追蹤中試驗狀態異動——近期更新者（ALT001 兩案 NCT07514923／NCT07476352、Teva NCT07197866、Alterity 相關登錄、Dasher YA-101 NCT06848231）皆為本站既有筆數且狀態未變；Soufflé Therapeutics 的 SFL-0821 一／二期（NCT07798609）經逐筆確認適應症為顏面肩胛肱骨型肌失養症（FSHD）、非 MSA，依例排除，Roche RO7204239（SMA）、ENCell EN001（肌少症）、多筆自然史與生物標記觀察性研究亦同。PubMed 窗內另有六筆不予收錄（晚期帕金森症候群安寧照護模式、腸道菌叢綜論、帕金森氏症排尿功能共識、神經源性矛盾性聲帶運動綜論、RBD 與突觸核蛋白病變綜論、帕金森氏症嗜中性球／淋巴球比值統合分析）——均以帕金森氏症或廣泛神經退化疾病為主體，MSA 僅屬順帶提及。產業面窗內無任何一手的資料或法規里程碑：Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug（最新一手里程碑仍為 2026/03 Ph3 MASCOT 完成隨機分派）、小野 ONO-2808、Teva emrusolmin、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464、Mayo MSC、思捷優達 YA-101、XellSmart XS411CN 窗內均無新公告。

en.body: Two papers added, both diagnostic biomarker studies in synucleinopathies; no trial changes. (1) A change to scanning method: this site's literature query previously searched only for 'multiple system atrophy' in the title; it now searches title and abstract and includes MSA-P and MSA-C. That surfaced two studies whose titles do not mention MSA but whose content bears directly on MSA differential diagnosis; each was checked individually for genuine MSA content before being recorded. (2) Are DaT SPECT and alpha-synuclein skin biopsy complementary or redundant? (BMJ Neurology Open 8(2):e001759; Martinez-Nunez AE et al. with senior author McFarland NR, Norman Fixel Institute, University of Florida; doi:10.1136/bmjno-2026-001759; 2026/09/03): a retrospective review of patients seen between January 2022 and March 2025 presenting with parkinsonism or tremor but not yet meeting criteria for PD, MSA or DLB, of whom 86 had a skin biopsy and 52 of those also had DaT SPECT. Sensitivity was identical for both (79.0%), with specificities of 74.0% and 81.0%; combined interpretation raised sensitivity to 95.6% and cut specificity to 59.9%; and 30.8% of dual-tested patients had discordant results — those DaT-positive but biopsy-negative more often had hyposmia and the reverse pattern more often had RBD, with almost half of the discordant cases eventually diagnosed with idiopathic Parkinson's disease. The authors conclude the two are complementary rather than redundant and are best used as rule-in tests early, since a negative result does not exclude disease. ⚠️ Retrospective, single centre, only 52 dual-tested; the reference standard is clinical diagnosis rather than pathology; and because the design excluded patients already meeting MSA criteria the findings cannot be extrapolated to a confirmed MSA population, with no MSA subgroup reported in the abstract. (3) Real-world clinical utility of P-SYN skin biopsy in outpatient practice (Frontiers in Neurology 17:1868980; Levine T et al., corresponding author Gibbons CH; doi:10.3389/fneur.2026.1868980; online 2026/08/25, indexed in PubMed 2026/09/10): among 100 outpatients with suspected neurodegenerative disease, biopsy was followed by a change in the recorded ICD-10 diagnosis in 60% and a change in the treatment plan in 91%. ⚠️ Read the conflict of interest first: four authors including the first and corresponding authors are employees of CND Life Sciences, which sells skin biopsy testing, and three hold stock options in it (as declared), making this manufacturer-involved research; it is also retrospective, from a single private practice, with no control group, and its endpoint is whether the diagnosis and treatment plan changed rather than whether the diagnosis was correct, with no pathological or long-term follow-up gold standard and no MSA-specific count or result in the abstract. The rest of today's scan: ClinicalTrials.gov showed no new MSA trials and no status changes among tracked trials — the recently updated records (the two ALT001 trials NCT07514923 and NCT07476352, Teva's NCT07197866, the Alterity registrations and Dasher's YA-101 NCT06848231) are all already on this site with unchanged status. Soufflé Therapeutics' Phase 1/2 trial of SFL-0821 (NCT07798609) was checked individually and its indication is facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), not MSA, so it was excluded as usual, as were Roche's RO7204239 (SMA), ENCell's EN001 (sarcopenia) and several observational natural history and biomarker studies. Six further PubMed hits were not recorded (a palliative care model for late-stage parkinsonism, a gut microbiota review, a consensus on urinary dysfunction in Parkinson's disease, a review of neurogenic paradoxical vocal fold motion, a review of RBD and the synucleinopathies, and a meta-analysis of the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio in Parkinson's disease) — all are centred on Parkinson's disease or neurodegeneration generally, with MSA mentioned only in passing. No first-party data or regulatory milestone occurred on the industry side: Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug (whose latest first-party milestone remains completion of randomisation in the Phase 3 MASCOT trial in March 2026), Ono's ONO-2808, Teva's emrusolmin, Tiziana's foralumab, Ionis' ION464, the Mayo MSC programme, Dasher's YA-101 and XellSmart's XS411CN all issued nothing in the window.

body: 新增 1 則文獻；無試驗異動。福建醫科大學附屬第一醫院團隊於 Brain Stimulation 刊出經顱交流電刺激（tACS）治療小腦型 MSA（MSA-C）的隨機、雙盲、假刺激對照試驗（Chen X 等、通訊作者 Gan S 等，OSCCAR Investigators，doi:10.1016/j.brs.2026.103205，2026/09/09）。每日 40 分鐘、70 Hz、2 mA，每週 5 天共 2 週；主要指標第 2 週 UMSARS 總分變化：真刺激 −4.48 vs 假刺激 +0.30，平均差 −4.78（95% CI −6.61 至 −2.94），P<0.001，無與治療相關的嚴重不良事件；SARA 與步態亦改善，但自律神經（SCOPA-AUT）與生活品質（MSA-QoL）未改善。⚠️ 摘要未載明樣本數（本站不代填）；療程與追蹤僅 2 週、無持續效果資料；屬非藥物的短期症狀效果，不構成疾病修飾證據；fMRI 事後分析作者自陳僅屬假說生成。本日其餘掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 窗內無新的 MSA 試驗異動——最近異動仍為 09/09 的 ALT001 兩項試驗（NCT07514923、NCT07476352，已於前日收錄），同日 Roche RO7204239（SMA）與 ENCell EN001（肌少症）係「atrophy」字面命中或適應症不符者，依例排除。PubMed「multiple system atrophy」標題查詢窗內另 1 筆（Neuropathology 通訊，42711280）已於前日收錄。產業面窗內無任何一手的資料或法規里程碑：Alterity ATH434 最新實質進度仍為 Ph2 讀出後籌備 Ph3；Lundbeck amlenetug 最新一手里程碑仍為 2026/03 的 Ph3 MASCOT 完成隨機分派（公司稱主要結果預計 2027 Q3）；小野 ONO-2808、Teva emrusolmin、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464、Mayo MSC、思捷優達 YA-101、XellSmart XS411CN 窗內均無新的一手公開公告。

en.body: One paper added; no trial changes. A group at the First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University published a randomised, double-blind, sham-controlled trial of transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) in the cerebellar type of MSA (MSA-C) in Brain Stimulation (Chen X et al., corresponding authors including Gan S, OSCCAR Investigators, doi:10.1016/j.brs.2026.103205, 2026/09/09). Participants received 40-minute sessions at 70 Hz and 2 mA, 5 days a week for 2 weeks; on the primary endpoint, change in UMSARS total score at week 2, active stimulation scored −4.48 vs +0.30 for sham, a mean difference of −4.78 (95% CI −6.61 to −2.94), P<0.001, with no treatment-related serious adverse events; SARA and gait also improved, but autonomic symptoms (SCOPA-AUT) and quality of life (MSA-QoL) did not. ⚠️ The abstract does not state the sample size (none is supplied here); treatment and follow-up lasted only 2 weeks with no durability data; this is a short-term symptomatic effect of a non-drug intervention and not evidence of disease modification; the authors describe the post hoc fMRI findings as hypothesis-generating only. The rest of today's scan: ClinicalTrials.gov showed no new MSA trial changes in the window — the most recent remain the two ALT001 trials of 09/09 (NCT07514923 and NCT07476352, recorded the previous day), while Roche's RO7204239 (SMA) and ENCell's EN001 (sarcopenia) on the same day matched only on the word 'atrophy' or were off-indication, and were excluded as usual. The other PubMed hit for 'multiple system atrophy' in the title (the Neuropathology letter, 42711280) was recorded the previous day. No first-party data or regulatory milestone occurred on the industry side: Alterity's ATH434 remains at preparation for Phase 3 following its Phase 2 readout; Lundbeck's amlenetug still has 2026/03 as its most recent first-party milestone, completion of randomisation in the Phase 3 MASCOT trial (headline results expected Q3 2027); and Ono's ONO-2808, Teva's emrusolmin, Tiziana's foralumab, Ionis' ION464, the Mayo MSC programme, Dasher's YA-101 and XellSmart's XS411CN all issued nothing first-party in the window.

body: 新增 2 項臨床試驗、1 項在研療法、1 則文獻。①本站新收錄一條先前未追蹤的療法路線：ALT001（外泌體衍生神經修復蛋白）。北京天壇醫院王擁軍（Yilong Wang）以主辦者即主持人（sponsor-investigator）身分登錄的兩項並行早期一期試驗，登錄均於 2026-09-09 更新、皆為單一站點、皆收案中：NCT07514923（MSA 小腦型（MSA-C）專屬、隨機、鞘內注射併靜脈輸注雙途徑，鞘內 130 μg 於第 1／31／61 天、靜脈 130 μg 於第 2–14／32–44±3／62–74±5 天，估計 20 人，起始 2026-06-10，主要完成日 2027-01-31，兩項主要指標皆為安全性——至第 90±7 天之不良事件與嚴重不良事件、及實驗室／生命徵象／心電圖異常發生率）；NCT07476352（擴充試驗、納入全體 MSA、開放標示單臂、僅靜脈輸注 130 μg 於第 1–14／31–44±3／61–74±5 天共三個 30 天療程，估計 60 人，實際起始 2026-06-15，主要完成日 2027-10-30，主要指標含安全性與第 15／45±3／75±5／180±14 天之 UMSARS 自基線變化）。登錄將 ALT001 描述為源自幹細胞分泌之外泌體的神經修復蛋白。→ 之所以值得標記：此為本站目前唯一以幹細胞分泌體（secretome）而非細胞本身為藥物實體的 MSA 在研療法，與 Mayo、韓國各家的間質幹細胞輸注同屬「再生／修復」大類，但投的是細胞分泌物的蛋白成分而非活細胞。⚠️ 必須誠實標註四點：(1) 機制敘述全數僅出自主辦方自填的登錄文字，公開來源未見同儕審查之臨床前資料，亦未見蛋白身分、純化方式或製程說明，本站不代為背書；(2) 兩項試驗皆為單一站點、研究者發起，合計 n=80，且登錄未指明背後是否有商業開發者；(3) 擴充試驗雖以 UMSARS 為主要指標之一，但開放標示單臂、無安慰劑對照——MSA 為進行性疾病，單臂 UMSARS 變化無法與自然病程區辨；(4) 兩項試驗目前均無任何結果公開讀出。②文獻：東京都立神經病院與埼玉醫科大學國際醫療中心神經病理團隊於 Neuropathology 刊出通訊／評論（Letter）一篇，主題為長病程 MSA 腦中的星形膠細胞包涵體病理（Homma T 等，46(5):e70078，doi:10.1111/neup.70078）。⚠️ PubMed 記錄未附摘要、全文非開放取用，其具體主張與所評論之原著無法自公開來源確認——依不編造原則，本站僅登錄書目事實，不代寫結論；收錄理由在於方向本身值得標記（MSA 病理定義長期以寡突膠細胞胞質包涵體為核心，星形膠細胞角色相對少被系統性描述）。本日其餘掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 窗內除上述兩筆外無其他真正屬於 MSA 的療法型試驗異動——09/09 的 Roche RO7204239 併 risdiplam（NCT05115110）為脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（SMA）、ENCell EN001（NCT07808905）為肌少症，係「atrophy」字面命中或適應症不符者，逐筆確認後依例排除；09/08 蘇州大學附二院非典型帕金森症候群自然史（NCT07805967）與 09/02 Besta 嗅黏膜生物標記（NCT06846658）屬觀察性。窗內其餘 MSA 試驗（Teva 延伸試驗 NCT07197866、van Horne 腓腸神經移植 NCT06683365、瑞金 α-Syn H21 NCT07774585、思捷優達 YA-101 NCT06848231、Synusight SST001 NCT07604116、MODAG NCT07640542、Alterity NCT07729852）皆已在檔且狀態未變。產業面窗內無任何一手的資料或法規里程碑：Alterity ATH434 最新實質進度仍為 Ph2 讀出後籌備 Ph3；Lundbeck amlenetug 最新一手里程碑仍為 2026/03 的 Ph3 MASCOT 完成最後一名受試者隨機分派（公司稱主要結果預計 2027 Q3）；小野 ONO-2808、Teva emrusolmin、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464、Mayo MSC、思捷優達 YA-101、XellSmart XS411CN 窗內均無新的一手公開公告。

en.body: Two clinical trials, one investigational therapy and one paper added. (1) A therapeutic approach not previously tracked here is now recorded: ALT001, an exosome-derived nerve repair protein. Yilong Wang of Beijing Tiantan Hospital has registered two parallel early-phase-1 trials as a sponsor-investigator, both with registrations updated 2026-09-09, both single-site and both recruiting: NCT07514923 (specific to the cerebellar subtype, MSA-C, randomised, using both intrathecal and intravenous routes — 130 μg intrathecally on days 1, 31 and 61 plus 130 μg intravenously on days 2–14, 32–44±3 and 62–74±5; estimated enrolment 20, started 2026-06-10, primary completion 2027-01-31, with both primary outcomes being safety measures — adverse and serious adverse events through day 90±7, and laboratory, vital sign and ECG abnormalities); and NCT07476352 (the expansion study, enrolling MSA generally, open-label and single-arm, intravenous only at 130 μg on days 1–14, 31–44±3 and 61–74±5 across three 30-day cycles; estimated enrolment 60, actual start 2026-06-15, primary completion 2027-10-30, with primary outcomes covering safety and change from baseline in UMSARS at days 15, 45±3, 75±5 and 180±14). The registrations describe ALT001 as a nerve repair protein derived from exosomes secreted by stem cells. → Why this is worth flagging: it is currently the only MSA therapy tracked here whose drug substance is the stem cell secretome rather than the cells themselves, placing it in the same 'regenerative/repair' family as the mesenchymal stem cell infusions from Mayo and the Korean developers while administering secreted protein rather than living cells. ⚠️ Four things must be stated honestly: (1) the mechanistic description comes solely from the sponsor's own registry text, with no peer-reviewed preclinical data, protein identity, purification method or manufacturing description available publicly, and this site offers no endorsement; (2) both trials are single-site and investigator-initiated, totalling n=80, and the registrations name no commercial developer; (3) although the expansion study lists UMSARS among its primary outcomes, it is open-label, single-arm and uncontrolled — and since MSA is progressive, single-arm UMSARS change cannot be distinguished from natural history; and (4) neither trial has read out any results publicly. (2) Literature: the neuropathology group at Tokyo Metropolitan Neurological Hospital and Saitama Medical University International Medical Center published a correspondence piece (Letter) in Neuropathology on astrocytic inclusion pathology in long-course MSA (Homma T et al., 46(5):e70078, doi:10.1111/neup.70078). ⚠️ The PubMed record carries no abstract and the full text is not open access, so the letter's specific claims and the article it responds to cannot be confirmed from public sources — under this site's rule against fabrication, only the bibliographic facts are recorded and no conclusions are written on the authors' behalf. It is recorded because the direction itself is worth flagging: the pathological definition of MSA has long centred on glial cytoplasmic inclusions in oligodendrocytes, with the role of astrocytes comparatively little described in systematic terms. The rest of today's scan: beyond the two trials above, ClinicalTrials.gov showed no other genuine MSA therapeutic trial changes in the window — Roche's RO7204239 with risdiplam (NCT05115110) on 09/09 is in spinal muscular atrophy and ENCell's EN001 (NCT07808905) is in sarcopenia, both matching only on the word 'atrophy' or otherwise off-indication, and excluded after case-by-case checking; the atypical parkinsonism natural history study at Soochow University's Second Affiliated Hospital (NCT07805967) on 09/08 and Besta's olfactory mucosa biomarker study (NCT06846658) on 09/02 are observational. Every other MSA trial touched in the window (Teva's extension NCT07197866, van Horne's sural nerve graft NCT06683365, Ruijin's α-Syn H21 NCT07774585, Dasher's YA-101 NCT06848231, Synusight's SST001 NCT07604116, MODAG NCT07640542 and Alterity NCT07729852) is already on file and unchanged in status. No first-party data or regulatory milestone occurred on the industry side: Alterity's ATH434 remains at preparation for Phase 3 following its Phase 2 readout; Lundbeck's amlenetug still has 2026/03 as its most recent first-party milestone, the randomisation of the last patient in the Phase 3 MASCOT trial (headline results expected Q3 2027); and Ono's ONO-2808, Teva's emrusolmin, Tiziana's foralumab, Ionis' ION464, the Mayo MSC programme, Dasher's YA-101 and XellSmart's XS411CN all issued nothing first-party in the window.

body: ⚠️ 補掃說明：上一次成功發布為 2026/09/02，09/03 與 09/04 兩日排程未執行，本次一併回補三日。新增 2 則文獻，無試驗異動。①UCL Queen Square 團隊在 Acta Neuropathologica 發表寡突膠細胞體細胞 SNCA 拷貝數增加與包涵體及發病年齡的關聯（152(1):31，Morley C、Proukakis C 等，doi:10.1007/s00401-026-03077-4，2026/09/04，開放取用）。以 SNCA 螢光原位雜交併 α-突觸核蛋白與 SOX10 免疫螢光，在 13 例紋狀體黑質變性、12 例橄欖腦橋小腦萎縮、15 例對照腦中，把訊號定位到寡突膠細胞：MSA 的體細胞 SNCA 拷貝數變異顯著高於對照（增加 6.3% vs 2.0%、減少 12.5% vs 7.4%，兩者 p < 0.0001）；「增加」集中在各亞型優先受累腦區（SND 殼核、OPCA 小腦），同一細胞內併見 α-突觸核蛋白包涵體的機率高出兩倍（p < 0.0001），且增加負荷愈高、發病年齡愈早（rho = −0.45，p = 0.03）；「減少」則無腦區偏好、與包涵體關聯有限、與發病年齡無關。另以 γH2AX 檢視 DNA 雙股斷裂，MSA 陽性細胞比例高於對照（4.9% vs 2.5%，p = 0.01），寡突膠細胞尤著（9.7% vs 2.5%，p = 0.024）。⚠️ 死後腦組織橫斷面關聯研究，無法判定因果或先後；各組僅 12–15 例；作者自陳 SNCA 減少與 DNA 雙股斷裂仍待進一步研究；全文無任何治療、藥物或試驗資料。②日本岐阜大學團隊在 JoVE 發表帕金森氏症與 MSA 自律神經功能的床邊評估操作流程（Mori Y 等、通訊作者 Shimohata T，doi:10.3791/71986，2026/09/03）。流程涵蓋循環（含 10 秒冷水壓力負荷試驗、主動站立試驗、R-R 間期變異係數，並指出整夜血氧監測可為 MSA 提供更進一步評估）、泌汗（湯匙測試、溫水浸泡後手指皺褶）、泌尿（排尿日記、殘尿量測量）、腸道（腹部叩診、直腸超音波）四面向。⚠️ 方法學論文，非臨床試驗，無病人結果數據；作者自陳結果受檢查者經驗、用藥與環境影響，必要時仍應做完整診斷性檢查；未提供任何診斷準確度指標，亦無前瞻性驗證或檢查者間信度資料。本次其餘掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 窗內無任何真正屬於 MSA 的試驗異動——09/03 兩筆異動分別為 Roche risdiplam 的脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（SMA）與 SFL-0821 的顏面肩胛肱肌失養症（FSHD），係「atrophy」字面命中的無關試驗，依例排除；窗外最近的 MSA 相關異動為 NCT07604116（SST001 影像劑）與 NCT03648905（慢性自律神經衰竭實驗室評估），均為 09/01、且非新資訊。PubMed「multiple system atrophy」標題查詢窗內 3 筆，除本次收錄 2 筆外，血漿神經絲輕鏈鑑別 MSA 與帕金森氏症一文（EBioMedicine，2026/08/31）已於前次收錄。產業面：Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、小野 ONO-2808、Teva TEV-56286（emrusolmin）、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464、Mayo MSC 與思捷優達 YA-101 窗內均無新的一手公開公告。

en.body: ⚠️ Backfill note: the last successful publication was 2026/09/02; the scheduled runs for 09/03 and 09/04 did not execute, so this run covers all three days. Two papers added; no trial changes. ① A UCL Queen Square team reports in Acta Neuropathologica that oligodendroglial somatic SNCA copy number gains are associated with inclusions and with age at disease onset (152(1):31; Morley C, Proukakis C et al.; doi:10.1007/s00401-026-03077-4; 2026/09/04; open access). Combining fluorescent in situ hybridisation for SNCA with α-synuclein and SOX10 immunofluorescence across 13 striatonigral degeneration, 12 olivopontocerebellar atrophy and 15 control brains, the study localises the signal to oligodendrocytes: somatic SNCA copy number variants were significantly higher in MSA than controls (gains 6.3% vs 2.0%, losses 12.5% vs 7.4%; p < 0.0001 for both). Gains clustered in each subtype's preferentially affected region (putamen in SND, cerebellum in OPCA), carried a twofold increased presence of α-synuclein inclusions in the same cell (p < 0.0001), and a higher gain burden correlated with earlier onset (rho = −0.45, p = 0.03); losses showed no regional predilection, limited association with inclusions and no correlation with onset. Using γH2AX to look for DNA double-strand breaks, the proportion of positive cells was higher in MSA than controls (4.9% vs 2.5%, p = 0.01) and most markedly so in oligodendrocytes (9.7% vs 2.5%, p = 0.024). ⚠️ This is a cross-sectional association study in post-mortem tissue and cannot establish causation or sequence; groups comprise only 12–15 brains; the authors state that the SNCA losses and the DNA double-strand breaks require further investigation; and the paper contains no treatment, drug or trial data. ② A Gifu University team publishes bedside protocols for assessing autonomic dysfunction in Parkinson's disease and MSA in JoVE (Mori Y et al., corresponding author Shimohata T; doi:10.3791/71986; 2026/09/03), covering four domains: circulatory (including the 10-second cold water stress load test, the active standing test and the coefficient of variation of R-R intervals, with overnight oximetry noted as adding further detail in MSA), sudomotor (the spoon test, finger wrinkling after warm-water immersion), urinary (voiding diaries, post-void residual measurement) and bowel (abdominal percussion, rectal ultrasonography). ⚠️ A methods paper, not a clinical trial, with no patient outcome data; the authors state that results are influenced by examiner experience, medication and testing environment and that fuller diagnostic evaluation should follow where needed; and it offers no measures of diagnostic accuracy, no prospective validation and no inter-rater reliability data. The rest of this scan: ClinicalTrials.gov showed no genuine MSA trial activity in the window — the two entries that moved on 09/03 were Roche's risdiplam in spinal muscular atrophy and SFL-0821 in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy, unrelated studies caught by the literal word "atrophy" and excluded as usual; the nearest MSA-relevant updates, NCT07604116 (the SST001 imaging agent) and NCT03648905 (chronic autonomic failure laboratory evaluation), both fall outside the window at 09/01 and carry nothing new. The PubMed "multiple system atrophy" title query returned three hits in the window; beyond the two added here, the plasma neurofilament light paper distinguishing MSA from Parkinson's disease (EBioMedicine, 2026/08/31) was recorded in the previous run. On the industry side, Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808, Teva's TEV-56286 (emrusolmin), Tiziana's foralumab, Ionis's ION464, the Mayo MSC programme and Dasher Neuroscience's YA-101 all issued no new primary public announcements in the window.

body: 新增 1 則文獻：下泌尿道症狀（LUTS）作為巴金森症候群的診斷線索——給神經科醫師的實務架構（Movement Disorders Clinical Practice，美國克里夫蘭診所神經研究所與泌尿研究所 Anis S、Anis O、Siddiqui JH，合著者任職維吉尼亞聯邦大學帕金森氏症暨動作障礙中心 Lenka A，doi:10.1002/mdc3.70780，電子版 2026/09/01）。作者指出 LUTS 是巴金森症候群光譜中最常見的非運動症狀之一，卻長期被低度利用為診斷與處置訊號。與 MSA 直接相關的判讀：各疾病症狀型態不同——尿滯留指向多系統萎縮症，而帕金森氏症的夜尿多為多因性；文中並提醒抗蕈毒鹼類藥物在此族群的風險會相互疊加。所提架構為四步驟：症狀分類 → 殘尿量測量 → 危險徵象辨識 → 針對性藥物處置。收錄理由：自律神經功能障礙（含泌尿功能）本就是 MSA 現行診斷準則的核心要素，而早期與帕金森氏症的鑑別是本領域最實際的難題。⚠️ 綜論性質、非原始研究、非系統性回顧，無新數據，且未提供任何診斷準確度的量化指標（無敏感度、特異度或 AUC）；所提架構未經前瞻性驗證，作者自身將其定位為實用架構而非已驗證的診斷準則；不含任何藥物療效或試驗資料，「尿滯留指向 MSA」屬型態性提示、不能單獨用於診斷。本日另完成：ClinicalTrials.gov MSA 條件查詢——窗內異動的療法型試驗皆已收錄（NCT07604116 上海賽路希 SST001、NCT07197866 Teva TEV-56286 延伸、NCT06683365 自體腓腸神經移植、NCT07774585 瑞金醫院 α-Syn H21 單株抗體、NCT06848231 思捷優達 YA-101、NCT07729852 Alterity ATH434 開放取得、NCT07640542 MODAG PET 造影劑），觀察性研究（NCT06596746 MARKERS-NDD、NCT06846658 Besta 嗅黏膜生物標記、NCT05913687 佛羅里達大學影像鑑別、NCT06209515 Kuopio 登錄分析、NCT04753320 麻省總醫院 PSP 遠距監測）依準則不收；其餘命中仍為 SMA、DMD、肌強直性失養症、FSHD、前列腺癌等「atrophy」字面命中的無關試驗，已逐筆確認適應症後排除。PubMed 標題／摘要查詢窗內 2 筆，另一筆（血漿 NfL 早期鑑別 MSA 與 PD）已於昨日收錄。產業新聞面：Lundbeck amlenetug（Ph3 MASCOT 已完成隨機分派）、Alterity ATH434（2026/05 資料支持推進三期）、Ono ONO-2808（2026/05 世界帕金森大會壁報）、Teva emrusolmin、Tiziana foralumab 窗內均無新的一手公開里程碑。

en.body: Added one paper: lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) as diagnostic clues in parkinsonism — a practical framework for neurologists (Movement Disorders Clinical Practice; Anis S, Anis O and Siddiqui JH at the Neurological Institute and Urological Institute, Cleveland Clinic Foundation, with Lenka A at the VCU Parkinson's Disease and Movement Disorder Center; doi:10.1002/mdc3.70780; e-published 2026/09/01). The authors note that LUTS are among the most prevalent non-motor complaints across the parkinsonian spectrum yet remain underused as diagnostic and management signals. The reading that bears directly on MSA: symptom patterns differ by disease — urinary retention points towards multiple system atrophy, whereas nocturia in Parkinson's disease is typically multifactorial — and the review warns that antimuscarinic drugs carry compounded risks in this population. The proposed framework runs in four steps: symptom classification, postvoid residual measurement, red-flag identification, and targeted pharmacologic guidance. Why it is here: autonomic dysfunction, urinary function included, is already central to the current MSA diagnostic criteria, and distinguishing MSA from Parkinson's disease early is the field's most practical difficulty. ⚠️ A review, not primary research and not a systematic review: no new data, and no quantitative measures of diagnostic accuracy — no sensitivity, specificity or AUC; the framework is not prospectively validated and the authors present it as a pragmatic aid rather than a validated diagnostic rule; it contains no drug efficacy or trial data, and the association of urinary retention with MSA is a pattern-level clue that cannot diagnose on its own. Also completed today: the ClinicalTrials.gov MSA condition query, where every therapeutic trial that moved in the window is already recorded — NCT07604116 (Synusight Biotech's SST001), NCT07197866 (Teva's TEV-56286 extension), NCT06683365 (autologous sural nerve grafting), NCT07774585 (Ruijin Hospital's α-Syn H21 monoclonal antibody), NCT06848231 (Dasher Neuroscience's YA-101), NCT07729852 (Alterity's ATH434 post-trial access) and NCT07640542 (MODAG's PET imaging agent). Observational studies were not recorded under the criteria (NCT06596746 MARKERS-NDD, NCT06846658 olfactory mucosa biomarkers at Istituto Neurologico Carlo Besta, NCT05913687 automated imaging differentiation at the University of Florida, NCT06209515 the Kuopio register analysis, NCT04753320 remote monitoring in PSP at Massachusetts General Hospital), and the remaining hits were again SMA, DMD, myotonic dystrophy, FSHD and prostate-cancer trials matching on the word 'atrophy', excluded one by one after checking each indication. The PubMed title/abstract query returned two hits in the window; the other — plasma NfL for early differentiation of MSA from PD — was recorded yesterday. On industry news: Lundbeck's amlenetug (Phase 3 MASCOT randomisation complete), Alterity's ATH434 (May 2026 data supporting advancement to Phase 3), Ono's ONO-2808 (a May 2026 poster at the World Parkinson Congress), Teva's emrusolmin and Tiziana's foralumab posted no new primary public milestones in the window.

body: 新增 2 則文獻，兩篇都是規模與設計值得注意的原始研究。①血漿神經絲輕鏈（NfL）用於早期區辨 MSA 與帕金森氏症（EBioMedicine 131，中國首都醫科大學附屬北京天壇醫院等五家動作障礙轉診中心，通訊作者 Feng T／Mao W／Chen Z，doi:10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106461）：多中心橫斷面診斷準確度研究，2018/01–2024/06 收案共 2408 人（PD 782、MSA 796、健康對照 830），依收案期間切為發現組與時間分隔的驗證組。NfL 為表現最佳的單一標記，發現組 AUC 0.920（95% CI 0.903–0.936）；切點 41.3 pg/mL 於發現組達敏感度 90.5%／特異度 83.4%、驗證組 86.7%／85.5%（AUC 0.924）；早期病人次組仍有 AUC 0.943。加上 GFAP、總 tau 與 p-tau217 的多標記模型只帶來有限的額外區辨力，作者因此主張對診斷不明的巴金森症候群採「NfL 優先」的簡化策略。⚠️ 橫斷面設計、MSA 與 PD 兩組均為臨床診斷而非病理確診、五個中心全在中國、切點綁定於本研究所用的光起始化學發光平台，換平台不可直接沿用；無任何治療或療效資料。②BIN1 的 AGG 重複擴增與蛋白聚集（Brain，日本廣島大學原爆放射線醫科學研究所等九所大學，資深作者 Kawakami H，doi:10.1093/brain/awag194）：MSA 至今尚未找出任何致病基因；作者由一位家族性 MSA 病人的全基因體定序發現 BIN1 第一個內含子的 AGG 重複擴增，續以臨床診斷 MSA 224 人、病理確診 67 人、血液對照 574 份、腦部對照 65 份篩檢。病理確診組中「超過 80 個重複」的頻率為 13.4%、腦部對照為 0%（P=0.003），但臨床診斷組對血液對照未達顯著（4.5% vs 2.4%，P=0.16）；帶擴增者腦中 BIN1 陽性膠質細胞質包涵體較常見，而不可溶 BIN1 在 MSA 腦中增加且與是否帶擴增無關。⚠️ 陽性訊號僅見於病理確診組、勝算比信賴區間極寬（下界 2.1、上界無限大）、病理與生化子分析僅個位數至十餘例、單一國家世代且尚無獨立複製；屬關聯與描述性證據，未以功能實驗證明因果。本日另完成：ClinicalTrials.gov MSA 條件查詢——窗內異動的 NCT07604116（上海賽路希生物 PET 造影劑之安全性、耐受性、生物分佈與輻射劑量學研究）、NCT07197866（Teva TEV-56286 延伸試驗）、NCT06683365（自體腓腸神經移植至黑質）三筆皆已收錄，NCT06846658（義大利 Besta 研究所嗅黏膜／血液／尿液生物標記）與 NCT07657520（華西醫院高海拔神經退化世代，已撤回）屬觀察性研究不收；其餘命中仍為 SMA、DMD、肌強直性失養症、前列腺癌等「atrophy」字面命中的無關試驗，已逐筆排除。PubMed 標題查詢窗內 2 筆命中即上述兩篇，皆為新收。

en.body: Added two papers, both primary studies notable for their scale and design. ① Plasma neurofilament light (NfL) for early differentiation of MSA from Parkinson's disease (EBioMedicine 131; five movement-disorder referral centres in China led from Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University; corresponding authors Feng T, Mao W and Chen Z; doi:10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106461): a multicentre cross-sectional diagnostic-accuracy study enrolling 2408 participants between January 2018 and June 2024 (782 PD, 796 MSA, 830 healthy controls), split by enrolment period into discovery and temporally separated validation datasets. NfL was the best single biomarker, with a discovery AUC of 0.920 (95% CI 0.903–0.936); a cutoff of 41.3 pg/mL gave 90.5% sensitivity and 83.4% specificity in discovery and 86.7% and 85.5% in validation (AUC 0.924), and held at AUC 0.943 in the early-stage subgroup. Adding GFAP, total tau and p-tau217 produced only limited incremental discrimination, leading the authors to argue for a simplified NfL-first strategy in diagnostically uncertain parkinsonism. ⚠️ Cross-sectional design; both the MSA and PD groups were clinically rather than pathologically diagnosed; all five centres are in China; and the cutoff is tied to the light-initiated chemiluminescence platform used here and cannot be carried across assays unchanged. No treatment or efficacy data. ② AGG repeat expansion and aggregation of BIN1 (Brain; Research Institute for Radiation Biology and Medicine, Hiroshima University, with eight further Japanese universities; senior author Kawakami H; doi:10.1093/brain/awag194): no causative gene for MSA has been identified to date. Whole-genome sequencing of one patient with familial MSA revealed an AGG repeat expansion in the first intron of BIN1, after which the authors screened 224 clinically diagnosed and 67 pathologically confirmed MSA patients against 574 blood and 65 brain control samples. In the pathologically confirmed group, expansions exceeding 80 repeats occurred at 13.4% versus 0% in brain controls (P=0.003), but the clinical group did not differ significantly from blood controls (4.5% vs 2.4%, P=0.16). BIN1-positive glial cytoplasmic inclusions were more frequent in the brains of expansion carriers, while insoluble BIN1 was increased in MSA brains irrespective of repeat status. ⚠️ The positive signal appears only in the pathologically confirmed group; the odds ratio's confidence interval is very wide (lower bound 2.1, upper bound infinity); the pathological and biochemical sub-analyses involve single figures to low double figures; and the cohort is from one country with no independent replication yet — this is associative and descriptive evidence without functional proof of causation. Also completed today: the ClinicalTrials.gov MSA condition query, where the three studies that moved in the window — NCT07604116 (Synusight Biotech, Shanghai; safety, tolerability, biodistribution and radiation dosimetry of a PET imaging agent), NCT07197866 (Teva's TEV-56286 extension trial) and NCT06683365 (autologous sural nerve grafting to the substantia nigra) — are all already recorded; NCT06846658 (olfactory mucosa, blood and urine biomarkers, Istituto Neurologico Carlo Besta, Italy) and NCT07657520 (West China Hospital's high-altitude neurodegeneration cohort, withdrawn) are observational and were not recorded; the remaining hits were again SMA, DMD, myotonic dystrophy and prostate-cancer trials matching on the word 'atrophy', excluded one by one. The PubMed title query returned exactly the two papers added here.

body: 新增 1 筆試驗＋1 則文獻。①試驗：LEAP（NCT06683365）——自體腓腸神經組織移植至黑質的 Ph1 可行性與安全性試驗，主持人 Craig van Horne 醫師（美國肯塔基大學，單一站點），雙盲、含假手術對照，估計收案 7 人（4 移植、3 假手術），納入診斷早期、症狀負擔較輕的帕金森病或 MSA 病人，起始 2025-02-25、主要完成日 2028-12-02，登錄於 2026-08-31 更新。這是一項組織／細胞層面的介入，但登錄未分列 MSA 的實際人數，且主要評估項目為安全性與可行性、非療效，目前無任何結果讀出。②文獻：類淋巴系統（glymphatic）功能失調在小腦神經退化中的角色綜論，涵蓋 MSA、SCA3、PSP 與原發性顫抖症，機轉包括 AQP4 極性錯置、神經發炎、血管變化與睡眠相依體液動力學，並回顧擴散張量影像等評估方法（Neurological Sciences）；屬綜論、非因果證明，且三位作者中兩位任職於私人公司。本日另完成：ClinicalTrials.gov MSA 條件查詢（已逐筆排除 SMA／DMD／肌強直性失養症等「atrophy」字面命中的無關試驗）與 PubMed 標題查詢，除上述外未見其他新增。

en.body: Added 1 trial and 1 paper. ①Trial: LEAP (NCT06683365) — a Phase 1 feasibility and safety study of autologous sural nerve tissue grafting into the substantia nigra, led by Craig van Horne, MD, PhD (University of Kentucky, USA, single site), double-blind with a sham-surgery control, an estimated 7 participants (4 graft, 3 sham), enrolling people with Parkinson's disease or MSA who are early in their diagnosis with a lower symptom burden, started 2025-02-25 with a primary completion date of 2028-12-02, registration updated 2026-08-31. This is a tissue/cell-level intervention, but the registration does not break out how many participants will have MSA, its primary outcomes are safety and feasibility rather than efficacy, and no results have been read out. ②Paper: a review of glymphatic dysfunction in cerebellar neurodegeneration spanning MSA, SCA3, PSP and essential tremor, covering AQP4 mispolarisation, neuroinflammation, vascular alterations and sleep-dependent fluid dynamics, and surveying assessment methods including diffusion tensor imaging (Neurological Sciences); it is a review rather than causal evidence, and two of its three authors are affiliated with a private company. Also completed today: the ClinicalTrials.gov MSA condition query (with SMA, DMD, myotonic dystrophy and other incidental "atrophy" string matches excluded case by case) and the PubMed title query, which surfaced nothing further.

body: 新增 1 筆登錄：Alterity 的 ATH434 試驗後續用計畫（NCT07531433）。這不是新的臨床試驗，而是一個擴大同意使用（Expanded Access）計畫、中型規模，狀態為「可提供（Available）」（2026/04/15 首次登錄並最後更新，資料驗證日 2026/03）：開放給已完成 Ph2 試驗 ATH434-201 或 ATH434-202 的病人續用 ATH434 錠劑，口服每日兩次、隨餐服用，最長 12 個月；資格需主治醫師評估可自續用獲益、先前未曾中止 ATH434，且無會惡化風險效益比的重大身心疾病。地點為美國，收容上限 20 人。與平台已收錄的 NCT07729852（ATH434-203）是兩個不同管道——後者僅開放法國 ATH434-201 完成者、上限 5 人。⚠️ 擴大同意使用計畫不設對照組、不以療效為目的，不會產出可用於評估藥效的數據；本筆不含任何療效或安全性結果，亦不代表任何法規進展。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 的 multiple system atrophy 查詢無新的 MSA 療法試驗——窗內異動的 NCT06846658（義大利 Besta 研究所嗅黏膜／血／尿早期生物標記）、NCT03648905（美國 NINDS 慢性自律神經衰竭評估）、NCT07657520（華西醫院高原神經退化世代，已撤回）、NCT05913687（佛羅里達大學帕金森症候群影像鑑別）、NCT04753320（麻省總醫院 PSP 遠距監測）均屬觀察性／影像／生物標記研究，依準則排除；另 NCT04620382（范德堡大學 midodrine 對照腹部加壓、Early Ph1、已完成）為學術性症狀治療的小型比較研究、非疾病修飾療法，本次亦未收錄。其餘命中的 SMA（salanersen、risdiplam）、DMD（ENTR-601-44／-45、GRT6019、DYNE-251）、肌強直性失養症（VX-670、PGN-EDODM1）、前列腺癌（AZD9750）等為「atrophy」字面命中，已逐筆確認適應症後排除。PubMed 窗內命中 1 筆（PMID 42663379）已收錄。追蹤中的業者（Alterity、Lundbeck amlenetug、Ono ONO-2808、Teva TEV-56286、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464、Dasher Neuroscience YA-101、BioArctic exidavnemab、瑞金醫院 α-Syn H21）窗內未見新的一手公開新聞稿。

en.body: One registry record added: Alterity's ATH434 post-trial access programme (NCT07531433). This is not a new clinical trial but an expanded access programme of intermediate size, listed as "Available" (first posted and last updated 2026/04/15, record verified 2026/03). It offers continued ATH434 tablets to patients who completed the Phase 2 studies ATH434-201 or ATH434-202, taken orally twice daily with food for up to 12 months; eligibility requires the treating physician to judge that the patient would benefit from continuing, that the patient has not previously discontinued ATH434, and that no significant medical or psychiatric condition would worsen the risk-benefit balance. It is sited in the United States with a cap of 20 patients. It is a separate route from NCT07729852 (ATH434-203), already recorded here, which is open only to French completers of ATH434-201 and capped at 5. ⚠️ An expanded access programme has no control arm, is not designed to measure efficacy, and will not generate data usable to judge the drug's effect; this record carries no efficacy or safety results and does not represent regulatory progress. The rest of the scan: the ClinicalTrials.gov multiple system atrophy query surfaced no new MSA therapeutic trial. The records that moved in the window — NCT06846658 (the Besta Institute in Italy, olfactory mucosa, blood and urine early biomarkers), NCT03648905 (the US NINDS evaluation of chronic autonomic failure), NCT07657520 (West China Hospital's high-altitude neurodegeneration cohort, withdrawn), NCT05913687 (automated imaging differentiation of parkinsonism at the University of Florida) and NCT04753320 (remote monitoring in PSP at Massachusetts General) — are observational, imaging or biomarker studies and were excluded under the criteria. NCT04620382 (Vanderbilt's completed Early Phase 1 comparison of midodrine against abdominal compression) is a small academic study of symptomatic management rather than a disease-modifying therapy and was likewise not recorded. The remaining hits — SMA (salanersen, risdiplam), DMD (ENTR-601-44/-45, GRT6019, DYNE-251), myotonic dystrophy (VX-670, PGN-EDODM1) and prostate cancer (AZD9750) — matched on the word 'atrophy' and were excluded after checking each indication. PubMed returned one hit in the window (PMID 42663379), already recorded. None of the companies tracked here (Alterity, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808, Teva's TEV-56286, Tiziana's foralumab, Ionis' ION464, Dasher Neuroscience's YA-101, BioArctic's exidavnemab, Ruijin Hospital's α-Syn H21) issued a new primary press release in the window.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：BIN1 基因 AGG 重複序列擴增與 MSA（Brain，日本 Kume K 等，通訊作者 Kawakami H，doi:10.1093/brain/awag194）。研究篩檢臨床診斷 MSA 224 例、病理確診 MSA 67 例，對照為血液 574 例、腦組織 65 例。兩層結果方向不一致：病理確診組中「重複次數 > 80」的擴增頻率顯著高於腦組織對照（13.4% vs 0%，P = 0.003），但臨床診斷組對血液對照未達顯著（4.5% vs 2.4%，勝算比 1.87，95% CI 0.8–4.5，P = 0.16）。作者另觀察到 BIN1 蛋白聚集。⚠️ 需注意勝算比為無限大係因對照組事件數為零，非效果量無窮大，其 95% CI 下界僅 2.1、且兩組各僅約 65 例，估計極不精確；臨床世代未能複製此關聯；受試者全為日本族群；本研究為關聯性觀察、未證因果，亦無任何治療介入資料。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 的 multiple system atrophy 查詢無新的 MSA 療法試驗——窗內異動的 NCT06846658（義大利 Besta 研究所以嗅黏膜／血／尿找帕金森病早期生物標記，08/28 更新）與 NCT03648905（美國 NINDS 慢性自律神經衰竭評估，08/27 更新）均屬觀察性／生物標記研究，依準則排除；其餘命中的 SMA、DMD、肌強直性失養症、前列腺癌等為「atrophy」字面命中，已逐筆確認適應症後排除。追蹤中的業者（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Ono ONO-2808、Teva TEV-56286、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464、Dasher Neuroscience YA-101、BioArctic exidavnemab、瑞金醫院 α-Syn H21）窗內未見新的一手公開新聞稿，其登錄內容亦無變化。

en.body: One new paper added: AGG repeat expansion in BIN1 and MSA (Brain; Kume K et al., Japan, corresponding author Kawakami H, doi:10.1093/brain/awag194). The study screened 224 clinically diagnosed and 67 pathologically confirmed MSA cases against 574 blood and 65 brain controls. The two layers of the result do not point the same way: in the pathologically confirmed group, expansions beyond 80 repeats were significantly more frequent than in brain controls (13.4% vs 0%, P = 0.003), but the clinically diagnosed group against blood controls did not reach significance (4.5% vs 2.4%, odds ratio 1.87, 95% CI 0.8–4.5, P = 0.16). The authors also report aggregation of the BIN1 protein. ⚠️ Note that the odds ratio is infinite only because the control group recorded zero events, not because the effect is unbounded: the lower bound of its confidence interval is 2.1, and with roughly 65 subjects in each arm the estimate is very imprecise. The clinical cohort did not reproduce the association; all participants were Japanese; and the work is associative, does not establish causation, and carries no therapeutic intervention data. The rest of the scan: the ClinicalTrials.gov multiple system atrophy query surfaced no new MSA therapeutic trial. The two records that changed in the window — NCT06846658 (the Besta Institute in Italy, searching olfactory mucosa, blood and urine for early Parkinson's disease biomarkers, updated 08/28) and NCT03648905 (the US NINDS evaluation of chronic autonomic failure, updated 08/27) — are observational biomarker studies and were excluded under the criteria; the remaining hits (SMA, DMD, myotonic dystrophy, prostate cancer) matched on the word 'atrophy' and were excluded after checking each indication. None of the companies tracked here (Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808, Teva's TEV-56286, Tiziana's foralumab, Ionis' ION464, Dasher Neuroscience's YA-101, BioArctic's exidavnemab, Ruijin Hospital's α-Syn H21) issued a new primary press release in the window, and their registry entries were unchanged.

body: 本次為補掃，無新增資料。上次成功發布為 2026-08-25，08-26 當日排程未執行，故本次一併回補 08-26～08-27 兩天的窗期（PubMed 以 reldate=4 拉長、CT.gov 以 LastUpdatePostDate 範圍檢視）。掃描結果：CT.gov 的 multiple system atrophy 查詢在窗內無新的 MSA 療法試驗——窗內三筆異動逐筆確認後均不收錄：NCT03648905（美國 NINDS 慢性自律神經衰竭之實驗室與影像評估，08/27 更新為 Completed）屬觀察性／影像研究；NCT07657520（華西醫院高海拔神經退化世代研究，08/25 更新）屬觀察性世代研究且狀態為 Withdrawn；NCT06671938（BioArctic exidavnemab Ph2a，08/21 更新為 Completed）已於 08/23 收錄、內容無變化。其餘命中多為 SMA、DMD、肌強直性失養症等「atrophy」字面命中，已逐筆確認適應症後排除。PubMed 的 "multiple system atrophy"[Title] 查詢窗內 0 筆；放寬至全欄位後唯一命中為 PMID 42634290（膠淋巴系統綜述），該筆已於 08/24 收錄，不重複新增。追蹤中的業者（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Ono ONO-2808、Teva TEV-56286、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464、Dasher Neuroscience YA-101、BioArctic）在窗內未見新的公開新聞稿；窗內出現的 MSA 產業報導為市場研究商的管線彙編新聞稿，非一手來源，依準則不予收錄。

en.body: This scan is a catch-up and added no new data. The last successful publication was 2026-08-25 and the scheduled run did not execute on 08-26, so this pass covers the 08-26 to 08-27 window in one go (PubMed widened via reldate=4, ClinicalTrials.gov reviewed across the LastUpdatePostDate range). Findings: the ClinicalTrials.gov multiple system atrophy query returned no new MSA therapeutic trial in the window. Three records changed and each was excluded on review: NCT03648905 (the US NINDS laboratory and imaging evaluation of chronic autonomic failure, updated to Completed on 08/27) is an observational imaging study; NCT07657520 (West China Hospital's high-altitude neurodegeneration cohort, updated 08/25) is an observational cohort and its status is Withdrawn; and NCT06671938 (BioArctic's exidavnemab Phase 2a, updated to Completed on 08/21) was already recorded on 08/23 with no change in content. The remaining hits were largely SMA, DMD and myotonic dystrophy studies matching on the word 'atrophy', excluded after checking the indication of each. The PubMed query "multiple system atrophy"[Title] returned nothing for the window; widening to all fields gave a single hit, PMID 42634290 (the glymphatic system review), which was already added on 08/24 and was not duplicated. None of the companies tracked here (Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808, Teva's TEV-56286, Tiziana's foralumab, Ionis' ION464, Dasher Neuroscience's YA-101, BioArctic) issued a new public press release within the window; the MSA industry coverage that did appear was a market research firm's pipeline round-up press release rather than a primary source, and was not included.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：韓國延世大學團隊於 Yonsei Medical Journal 發表《α-突觸核蛋白病變中的膠淋巴系統》綜述，彙整影像、病理與實驗證據，論述經血管周邊路徑與星形膠細胞 AQP4 通道進行腦脊髓液廢物清除的膠淋巴系統在帕金森病、路易氏體失智症與多系統萎縮症中的角色：DTI-ALPS 與 BOLD-CSF 耦合等進階磁振方法在三病中皆顯示膠淋巴流動受損並與認知運動退化相關；動物與屍檢研究顯示 AQP4 極化受破壞會加劇 α-突觸核蛋白堆積。⚠️ 屬綜述、無新原始數據，DTI-ALPS 為間接替代指標且效度仍有爭議，文中未提供 MSA 專屬效果量或診斷閾值，所述介入方向（睡眠優化、AQP4 藥理調節、器械式方法）均在研究階段、無任何已完成的 MSA 臨床療效讀出。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 的 multiple system atrophy 查詢窗內無新的 MSA 療法試驗——窗內最新兩筆 NCT07657520（華西醫院高海拔神經退化世代研究，且狀態為 Withdrawn）與 NCT03648905（NINDS 慢性自律神經衰竭之影像評估）皆屬觀察性／影像研究，依準則不收；其餘多為 SMA、DMD、肌強直性失養症等「atrophy」字面命中，逐筆確認後排除。既有試驗中 BioArctic 的 exidavnemab（NCT06671938）登錄於 08/21 更新為 Completed，內容與 08/23 已收錄者相同，未重複記錄。PubMed 的 "multiple system atrophy"[Title] 查詢窗內 0 筆，放寬至 Title/Abstract 後僅上述 1 筆。Alterity、Lundbeck、Ono、Teva、Tiziana、Ionis、Dasher Neuroscience 等追蹤中業者在窗內未見新的公開新聞稿（Alterity 2026-08-12 的 ATH434 物質組成專利已於當週收錄）。

en.body: One paper added. A team at Yonsei University in Korea published a review of the glymphatic system in α-synucleinopathies in the Yonsei Medical Journal, synthesising imaging, pathological and experimental evidence on the role of the glymphatic system — cerebrospinal-fluid waste clearance through perivascular pathways and astrocytic AQP4 channels — in Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies and multiple system atrophy: advanced MRI methods such as DTI-ALPS and BOLD–CSF coupling show impaired glymphatic flow across all three, correlating with cognitive and motor decline, while animal and postmortem work indicates that disrupted AQP4 polarisation exacerbates α-synuclein accumulation. ⚠️ It is a review with no new primary data; DTI-ALPS is an indirect proxy whose validity remains contested; the paper gives no MSA-specific effect sizes or diagnostic thresholds; and the intervention directions it surveys (sleep optimisation, pharmacological AQP4 modulation, device-based approaches) are all at a research stage with no completed clinical efficacy readout in MSA. Remaining coverage of this scan: the ClinicalTrials.gov multiple system atrophy query returned no new MSA therapeutic trial in the window — its two most recent entries, NCT07657520 (a high-altitude neurodegeneration cohort at West China Hospital, and now Withdrawn) and NCT03648905 (NINDS imaging evaluation of chronic autonomic failure), are both observational/imaging studies excluded under the criteria, and the remainder were SMA, DMD and myotonic dystrophy studies matching on the word 'atrophy', excluded after checking each one. Among trials already covered, BioArctic's exidavnemab (NCT06671938) was updated to Completed on 08/21, identical to what was recorded on 08/23, so it was not logged again. The PubMed "multiple system atrophy"[Title] query returned zero hits in the window; broadening to Title/Abstract yielded only the single paper above. No new public press releases were found in the window for Alterity, Lundbeck, Ono, Teva, Tiziana, Ionis or Dasher Neuroscience (Alterity's ATH434 composition-of-matter patent of 2026-08-12 was already captured that week).

body: 本筆一併回補 2026/08/21–08/23 三天（上次發布為 08/20，其間排程未執行，無資料缺口未回補）。（1）新增在研療法與試驗各 1 筆：BioArctic 的 exidavnemab（BAN0805）——α-synuclein 單株抗體，Ph2a「EXIST」研究（NCT06671938）已於 2026-08-10 完成，登錄於 2026-08-21 更新為 Completed。該研究同時納入輕中度帕金森病與 MSA 兩個族群，實際收案 38 人（原設計約 36 人、其中 MSA 約 12 人），2024-10-24 起始，2:1 隨機、四重盲、多重劑量遞增，站點為波蘭 2 站、西班牙 5 站；主要指標為不良事件與嚴重不良事件人數（安全性與耐受性），非療效。公司 2025-06 曾公布期中安全性審查為安全、耐受良好並據以啟動第二劑量世代，並公開表示正在籌備 Ph2b。⚠️ 截至目前無任何療效或生物標記結果公開讀出，且 MSA 族群僅約 12 人，本研究依設計即不足以支持療效推論。（2）新增 1 則科學文獻：德國呂北克團隊於 npj Parkinson's Disease 發表以 31P-MRSI 活體測量腦內高能磷酸代謝物的研究（MSA-P 12 人／MSA-C 12 人／帕金森病 24 人／健康對照 24 人），僅 MSA-C 於小腦顯示代謝物下降，基底核在各組間無差異。⚠️ 作者自陳為初步結果，每組僅 12 人，且基底核的陰性發現受該方法空間解析度限制影響、在 MSA-P 尤須謹慎；研究未評估任何治療。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 的 multiple system atrophy 查詢窗內多數命中為脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（SMA）、裘馨氏肌失養症（DMD）、肌強直性失養症與前列腺癌等「atrophy」字面命中，逐筆確認後排除；真為 MSA 但屬觀察性或影像研究者（如 AskBio 的 NCT05699460 基因治療前導觀察研究、NCT05913687 影像鑑別）依準則不收；既有試驗中 NCT07774585（瑞金醫院 α-Syn H21）與 NCT06848231（YA-101）登錄雖於 08/19 更新，內容與 08/20 已收錄者相同，未重複記錄。Alterity、Lundbeck、Ono、Teva、Tiziana、Ionis 等追蹤中業者在此三日窗內未見新的公開新聞稿。領域焦點（msa-news）本次未新增：exidavnemab 屬小規模 Ph2a 完成、無數據讀出，尚不構成領域級進展，故僅記於在研療法全景與試驗雷達。

en.body: This entry backfills the three days 2026/08/21–08/23 (the last publication was 08/20 and the schedule did not run in between; no gap is left uncovered). (1) One investigational therapy and one trial added: BioArctic's exidavnemab (BAN0805) — an alpha-synuclein monoclonal antibody whose Phase 2a 'EXIST' study (NCT06671938) completed on 2026-08-10, with the registration updated to Completed on 2026-08-21. The study enrolled both mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease and MSA cohorts, with an actual enrolment of 38 (against an original design of roughly 36, about 12 of them with MSA), started 2024-10-24, randomised 2:1, quadruple-blind and multiple ascending dose, across 2 sites in Poland and 5 in Spain; the primary outcome is the number of participants with adverse events and serious adverse events (safety and tolerability), not efficacy. In June 2025 the company reported an interim safety review finding the drug safe and well tolerated, on the basis of which the second dose cohorts opened, and it has said publicly that a Phase 2b is in preparation. ⚠️ No efficacy or biomarker results have been read out publicly to date, and with only about 12 MSA patients the study is by design unable to support efficacy inference. (2) One scientific paper added: a group in Lübeck, Germany published work in npj Parkinson's Disease using 31P-MRSI to measure high-energy phosphorus metabolites in vivo (12 MSA-P / 12 MSA-C / 24 Parkinson's disease / 24 healthy controls), finding reduced metabolite levels in the cerebellum in MSA-C only, with no differences between groups in the basal ganglia. ⚠️ The authors describe the findings as preliminary, with only 12 patients per subtype, and note that the negative basal ganglia result is constrained by the spatial resolution of the method and warrants particular caution in MSA-P; the study evaluated no treatment. Remaining coverage of this scan: most hits from the ClinicalTrials.gov multiple system atrophy query in the window were literal 'atrophy' matches for spinal muscular atrophy, Duchenne muscular dystrophy, myotonic dystrophy and prostate cancer, and were excluded after checking each one; genuine MSA studies that are observational or imaging-only (such as AskBio's NCT05699460 pre-gene-therapy observational study and NCT05913687 on imaging differentiation) are not collected under the criteria; and among existing trials, NCT07774585 (Ruijin Hospital, α-Syn H21) and NCT06848231 (YA-101) had registry updates on 08/19 whose content matches what was already recorded on 08/20, so they were not duplicated. No new public press releases were found in this three-day window from Alterity, Lundbeck, Ono, Teva, Tiziana or Ionis. Nothing was added to the field-focus panel (msa-news) this time: the completion of a small Phase 2a with no data readout does not yet amount to a field-level development, so it is recorded in the therapy landscape and trial radar only.

body: 當日第二次掃描的補收（當天稍早已發布一次，本筆只記其後出現的新事實）。新增 2 篇文獻，均屬鑑別診斷與評估方法層次，無新試驗、無在研療法進展。（1）史特拉斯堡大學醫院的 RFC1／CANVAS 對 MSA-C 前瞻研究（Journal of Neurology）：自 418 名散發性晚發型小腦共濟失調病人中辨識出 RFC1 相關共濟失調 20 人與 MSA-C 65 人，發現發病年齡較早、巴金森症候群／自律神經失調／錐體束症候群出現較晚、病程較慢與 RFC1 顯著相關（p < 0.05），且 RFC1 組中位存活期逾 20 年、顯著長於 MSA-C（p < 0.0001）。⚠️ RFC1 組僅 20 人、單一轉診中心，且未報告靈敏度／特異度或診斷閾值，屬群體層次關聯而非個案診斷準則。（2）名古屋大學與濱松醫科大學的標準化傾斜床測試操作流程（JoVE，影音方法論文）：以帕金森病與 MSA 為主要對象，規範由平躺轉直立過程的血壓量測以偵測心血管自律神經衰竭。⚠️ 這是操作規範與示範、不是臨床研究——無病人世代、無任何診斷準確度數據，不可引用為診斷效能證據。兩篇的共同關聯在收案端：MSA 迄今無確診生物標記、仍以臨床準則診斷，前者顯示誤診混入者可能系統性拉長存活、拖慢惡化速率而干擾以進展速率為終點的試驗，後者則是把診斷準則核心項目（神經性直立性低血壓）的量測程序標準化。本次補掃的其餘結果：CT.gov 的 MSA 查詢窗內更新者為 Vertex VX-670（肌強直性失養症 DM1）與 SyntrFuge 顏面脂肪移植（顏面萎縮），經逐筆確認適應症皆非 MSA、屬「atrophy」字面誤中，予以排除；窗內另兩筆 Ruijin 醫院 α-Syn H21（NCT07774585）與思捷優達 YA-101（NCT06848231）已於當天稍早的掃描收錄，非新事實。PubMed 窗內另 2 筆（Rasmussen 腦炎生酮飲食病例報告、阿茲海默症 Tim-3 微膠細胞綜述）與 MSA 無關，排除。

en.body: Backfill from a second scan the same day (an earlier run was published that morning; this entry records only facts that appeared afterwards). Two papers added, both at the level of differential diagnosis and assessment methodology; no new trials and no developments among investigational therapies. (1) A prospective RFC1/CANVAS versus MSA-C study from Strasbourg University Hospital (Journal of Neurology): from 418 patients with sporadic late-onset cerebellar ataxia the authors identified 20 with RFC1-related ataxia and 65 with MSA-C, finding that earlier age at onset, later onset of parkinsonism, dysautonomia and pyramidal signs and slower progression were significantly associated with RFC1 (p < 0.05), and that median survival in the RFC1 group exceeded 20 years, significantly longer than in MSA-C (p < 0.0001). ⚠️ The RFC1 group numbered only 20 patients at a single referral centre, and the paper reports no sensitivity, specificity or diagnostic thresholds, making these group-level associations rather than criteria for individual diagnosis. (2) A standardised head-up tilt test protocol from Nagoya University and Hamamatsu University (JoVE, a video methods paper): aimed principally at Parkinson's disease and MSA, it specifies blood-pressure measurement through the supine-to-upright transition to detect cardiovascular autonomic failure. ⚠️ This is a procedural specification and demonstration, not a clinical study — no patient cohort and no diagnostic accuracy data whatsoever — and cannot be cited as evidence of diagnostic performance. What links the two is the enrolment side: MSA still has no confirmatory biomarker and is diagnosed on clinical criteria, so the first paper shows how misclassified patients could systematically lengthen observed survival and slow apparent progression, distorting trials that use progression rate as an endpoint, while the second standardises the measurement procedure for neurogenic orthostatic hypotension, a core item of the diagnostic criteria. Remaining coverage of this supplementary scan: the CT.gov MSA query returned updates for Vertex's VX-670 (myotonic dystrophy type 1) and the SyntrFuge facial fat grafting study (facial atrophy), each checked and excluded as non-MSA literal 'atrophy' matches; the other two records in the window, Ruijin Hospital's α-Syn H21 (NCT07774585) and Dasher Neuroscience's YA-101 (NCT06848231), had already been captured in the earlier scan that day and are not new. Two further PubMed hits in the window (a ketogenic-diet case report in Rasmussen's encephalitis and a review of Tim-3 and microglia in Alzheimer's disease) were unrelated to MSA and excluded.

body: 新增 2 筆臨床試驗、1 家在研療法業者、1 篇文獻，是本站近期補收最多的一天。（1）先前漏收的 Ph2：思捷優達 Dasher Neuroscience（台灣）的 YA-101（NCT06848231）——口服D-胺基酸氧化酶（DAAO）抑制劑，公司自述機轉為抑制發炎細胞激素、降低神經發炎並促進神經可塑性。全球多中心、雙盲、安慰劑對照、劑量遞增；收 30 歲以上依 MDS 準則確診的 MSA 病人，MSA-P 與 MSA-C 皆收；主要終點為不良事件發生率與嚴重度，次要終點含藥物動力學、UMSARS 與 10 公尺步行測試；站點為美國 6 站、日本 1 站、台灣 2 站，登錄狀態已轉為收案完成、雙盲進行中（狀態查核日 2026-08）。⚠️ 收案人數兩個公開來源不一致：公司 2026-07-28 新聞稿稱完成 90 人，CT.gov 登錄預計收案 75 人，本站兩者並列、不擇一採信。法規面依公司公開資料載有 FDA 快速通道資格與美／日／歐盟孤兒藥資格，公開來源未載核予日期，故不填年份。公司稱 topline 預計 2027 Q1，登錄主要完成日 2027-06-30；目前無任何療效數據公開讀出。同步在「在研療法全景」新增該筆（category：dmt）。（2）新登錄的極早期試驗：上海瑞金醫院的 α-Syn H21 單株抗體（NCT07774585），人源化抗體、設計上選擇性結合病理性 α-synuclein 聚集體，靜脈輸注每 4 週一次共 3 劑、追蹤 12 週，預計 2026-09-15 起始。⚠️ n＝3、單一中心、研究者發起的探索性研究，樣本數不足以推論療效，登錄亦未載明開發廠商。（3）文獻：佛羅里達大學 Fixel 研究所與順天堂、北里、印度 AIIMS 合作，於 Journal of Parkinson's Disease 刊出非典型帕金森症候群復健的範疇綜述——依 PRISMA-ScR 檢索至 2025 年 5 月，納入 60 篇（其中 MSA 20 篇），結論為復健一致地安全可行，步態平衡訓練、發聲吞嚥治療與多模式方案有短期效益，但證據等級僅 AAN Class III–IV，且缺乏標準化療效指標。⚠️ 範疇綜述未做偏誤風險評估、未合併效果量，且結論涵蓋四種疾病、非 MSA 專屬。當日掃描結果：CT.gov MSA 查詢窗內其餘更新（Biogen salanersen、Entrada 兩筆 ENTR-601、Dyne DYNE-251、Roche risdiplam、AstraZeneca AZD9750）經逐筆確認適應症為 SMA、DMD 或前列腺癌，均屬「atrophy」字面誤中，予以排除；Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Ono ONO-2808、Teva TEV-56286 近 7 天無新事實。

en.body: Two clinical trials, one investigational-therapy developer and one paper added — the largest single day of backfill on this site in recent weeks. (1) A previously missed Ph2: YA-101 from Dasher Neuroscience (Taiwan) (NCT06848231) — an oral D-amino acid oxidase (DAAO) inhibitor that the company describes as inhibiting inflammatory cytokines, reducing neuroinflammation and enhancing neuroplasticity. The trial is global, multi-centre, double-blind, placebo-controlled and dose-escalating; it enrols MSA patients aged 30 and over diagnosed per MDS criteria, covering both MSA-P and MSA-C; the primary endpoint is the incidence and severity of adverse events, with pharmacokinetics, UMSARS and the 10-Metre Walk Test among the secondary endpoints; sites are in the United States (6), Japan (1) and Taiwan (2), and the registration now shows enrolment complete with the double-blind phase ongoing (status verified 2026-08). ⚠️ The two public sources disagree on enrolment: the company's 2026-07-28 press release states 90 completed, while the CT.gov registration lists a target of 75 — this site reports both rather than choosing between them. Company materials cite FDA Fast Track designation and orphan drug designation in the US, Japan and the EU; the public sources give no grant dates, so no years are stated. The company expects topline data in Q1 2027 and the registered primary completion date is 2027-06-30; no efficacy data have been read out publicly. A matching entry was added to the therapy landscape (category: dmt). (2) A newly registered, very early trial: the α-Syn H21 monoclonal antibody at Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai (NCT07774585), a humanised antibody designed to bind selectively to pathological alpha-synuclein aggregates, given by intravenous infusion every 4 weeks for 3 doses with 12 weeks of follow-up and a planned start of 2026-09-15. ⚠️ With n = 3, a single centre and an investigator-initiated exploratory design, it is far too small to support efficacy inference, and the registration names no developer. (3) Paper: the Fixel Institute at the University of Florida, with Juntendo, Kitasato and AIIMS India, published a scoping review of rehabilitation in atypical parkinsonian syndromes in the Journal of Parkinson's Disease — searching to May 2025 under PRISMA-ScR and including 60 studies (20 of them in MSA). It concludes that rehabilitation is consistently safe and feasible and that gait and balance training, voice and swallowing therapy and multimodal programmes show short-term benefits, but at an evidence level of only AAN Class III–IV and with no standardised outcome measures. ⚠️ A scoping review performs no risk-of-bias assessment and pools no effect sizes, and its conclusions span four disorders rather than being MSA-specific. Scan coverage today: the other CT.gov records updated inside the window (Biogen's salanersen, two Entrada ENTR-601 trials, Dyne's DYNE-251, Roche's risdiplam and AstraZeneca's AZD9750) were each checked and excluded as SMA, DMD or prostate cancer — literal 'atrophy' matches rather than MSA. Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808 and Teva's TEV-56286 produced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇。作法更正：前兩日的掃描兩度命中 Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging 一篇評介結構性 MRI 體積測量鑑別 PSP／PD／MSA 的社論（PubMed 42596062），並以「評論性短文、無原始數據」為由排除——排除社論本身仍屬正確，但當時未回頭去找它評介的原始論文。今日補上該原始論文：北京協和醫院與北京天壇醫院團隊的 PDSVI（parkinsonism volumetric index），一個全自動、不依賴特定軟體的腦容積指標，公式為（橋腦體積 × 第三腦室體積）/（中腦體積 × 視丘體積）× 10，用以取代現行需人工在特定切面測量、費時且受判讀者影響的 2D 指標。世代為 480 名病人（PD 246、PSP 108、MSA-C 63、MSA-P 63）加 252 名健康對照，隨機分訓練組 320／內部驗證組 160。內部驗證：區辨 PSP 與非 PSP AUC 0.897，對 PD 0.873、對 MSA-P 0.950、對 MSA-C 0.939、對健康對照 0.909，與人工測量的 MRPI 相當。⚠️ 限制須一併讀：單一國家、以中國人族群為主，僅內部驗證、無獨立外部世代；PDSVI 是為偵測 PSP 而設計，MSA 在此是對照組而非目標診斷，故高 AUC 反映的是把 MSA 排除在 PSP 之外的能力，不代表能區分 MSA-P 與 MSA-C，也不代表能把 MSA 與 PD 分開。原始論文出版日為 2026/07/01、落在 7 天窗外，之所以仍予收錄，是因為它是本站漏收的實質內容、且由窗內社論帶出；此一判斷在此記錄備查。PubMed 窗內其餘 6 筆均已在檔。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢近 7 天內無新試驗、亦無狀態變動：窗內更新者為 Entrada 兩筆 DMD 試驗、Grünenthal GRT6019（DMD）與 AstraZeneca AZD9750（前列腺癌），均屬「atrophy」字面誤中或非 MSA 適應症，逐筆確認適應症後排除。在研療法新聞掃描（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Ono ONO-2808）未見近 7 天內的新事實，檢索命中者均為既有已記錄事件之轉載。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar. A correction of method: the scans of the past two days twice hit an editorial in the Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (PubMed 42596062) reviewing structural MRI volumetry for distinguishing PSP, PD and MSA, and excluded it as a short commentary carrying no primary data. Excluding the editorial was right, but no one went back to find the original paper it was reviewing. That paper is added today: the PDSVI (parkinsonism volumetric index) from Peking Union Medical College Hospital and Beijing Tiantan Hospital, a fully automated, software-independent brain volumetry metric calculated as (pons volume × third ventricle volume) / (midbrain volume × thalamus volume) × 10, intended to replace the current 2D metrics, which must be measured manually on specific planes and are both laborious and observer-dependent. The cohort was 480 patients (246 PD, 108 PSP, 63 MSA-C, 63 MSA-P) plus 252 healthy controls, randomised into a training set of 320 and an internal validation set of 160. In internal validation it separated PSP from non-PSP with an AUC of 0.897, and from PD at 0.873, MSA-P at 0.950, MSA-C at 0.939 and healthy controls at 0.909 — comparable to the manually measured MRPI. ⚠️ The limitations belong with the figures: a single country and a predominantly Chinese population, with internal validation only and no independent external cohort. The PDSVI was designed to detect PSP, and MSA serves here as a comparator rather than the target diagnosis, so the high AUCs reflect the ability to exclude MSA from PSP; they do not indicate that MSA-P can be separated from MSA-C, nor that MSA can be separated from PD. The original paper was published on 2026/07/01, outside the 7-day window; it is recorded nonetheless because it is substantive content this site had missed and because the editorial that surfaced it fell inside the window — that judgement is noted here for the record. The other six PubMed hits in the window were already on file. Today's CT.gov query returned no new MSA trials and no status changes within the past 7 days: the records updated in the window were two Entrada DMD trials, Grünenthal's GRT6019 (DMD) and AstraZeneca's AZD9750 (prostate cancer), all either literal 'atrophy' matches or non-MSA indications and excluded after checking each. The sweep of investigational-therapy news (Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808) found no new facts within the past 7 days — every hit restated an event already on record.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇。多倫多大學 Tanz 神經退化疾病研究中心與大學健康網絡團隊發表於 Acta Neuropathologica，主題為路易體疾病（LBD）與 MSA 死後皮膚檢體中 α-突觸核蛋白種子活性（seeding）的差異。⚠️ 本筆刻意只記錄「已發表、主題為何」：該文為 Letter 體裁，PubMed 未收錄摘要、出版社端全文為付費牆，本平台無法查證樣本數、檢測平台與判別準確度，因此不轉述任何未經查證的結果數字。收錄理由在於方向而非結論——皮膚是活體可取得的組織，而 MSA 與 LBD（含帕金森病、路易體失智症）的生前鑑別診斷是本領域長期未解的實務問題：現行皮膚種子擴增試驗多半只能判定「有無 α-突觸核蛋白病理」，能否進一步分辨「是哪一種」尚未定案。本篇與 08/14 收錄的兩篇株型研究（PubMed 42600994、42601815）屬同一條研究線，作者群同樣出自 Tanz 中心（與 42601815 為不同實驗室）。在取得全文之前，不應假定本文已證實皮膚檢測可用於鑑別診斷，亦不應假定其適用於活體。另 PubMed 窗內第二筆命中為 Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging 之結構性 MRI 體積測量鑑別 PSP／PD／MSA 編輯評論，即昨日已評估並排除的同一篇（評論性短文、無原始數據），維持不予收錄。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢近 7 天內無新試驗、亦無狀態變動：窗內更新者為 Entrada 兩筆 DMD 試驗、Grünenthal GRT6019（DMD）、Biogen salanersen 與 Dyne DYNE-251、AstraZeneca AZD9750（前列腺癌），以及 Kuopio 大學醫院一筆神經退化疾病觀察性研究，均屬「atrophy」字面誤中或非 MSA 適應症，逐筆確認後排除。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar. From the Tanz Centre for Research in Neurodegenerative Disease at the University of Toronto and the University Health Network, in Acta Neuropathologica, on differences in α-synuclein seeding activity between post-mortem skin in Lewy body disease (LBD) and in MSA. ⚠️ This entry deliberately records only that the paper exists and what it is about: it is a Letter, PubMed carries no abstract, and the publisher's full text is paywalled, so the sample sizes, assay platform and discriminative accuracy could not be verified — and no result is being paraphrased unverified. It is included for its direction rather than its conclusion: skin is a tissue obtainable from living patients, and telling MSA from LBD (Parkinson's disease and dementia with Lewy bodies included) during life remains an unsolved practical problem in this field — existing skin seed-amplification assays can generally establish whether α-synuclein pathology is present, while whether they can establish which disease is unsettled. The paper belongs to the same line of work as the two strain papers recorded on 14 August (PubMed 42600994 and 42601815), and its authors are likewise from the Tanz Centre, in a different laboratory from 42601815. Until the full text is obtained, it should not be assumed that this establishes skin testing as a differential diagnostic, nor that it applies in living patients. The second PubMed hit in the window, an editorial in the Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging on structural MRI volumetry for distinguishing PSP, PD and MSA, is the same one assessed and excluded yesterday — a short commentary carrying no primary data — and remains excluded. Today's CT.gov query returned no new MSA trials and no status changes within the past 7 days: the records updated in the window were two Entrada DMD trials, Grünenthal's GRT6019 (DMD), Biogen's salanersen and Dyne's DYNE-251, AstraZeneca's AZD9750 (prostate cancer), and one observational neurodegenerative-disease study from Kuopio University Hospital — all either literal 'atrophy' matches or non-MSA indications, excluded after checking each.

body: 文獻雷達新增 2 篇，兩篇同日發表、同談 α-突觸核蛋白株型（strain），且方向互補。（1）哥本哈根大學醫院、羅斯基勒大學與法國 Institut François Jacob 團隊發表於 Neurobiology of Disease：以蛋白質錯誤摺疊循環放大從 MSA 與帕金森病腦組織擴增 α-突觸核蛋白纖維，接種至神經元培養與小鼠比較——MSA 來源纖維誘發較多磷酸化 α-突觸核蛋白病理，且誘發的寡突膠細胞病理顯著多於 PD 來源材料，支持兩病纖維具不同生物特性。這與 MSA 病理上以寡突膠細胞內膠質細胞質包涵體為定義特徵相符。屬動物與細胞實驗、非病人研究，「較強效」指實驗系統中的接種能力，不可外推為病程速度或治療反應；作者群含 H. Lundbeck A/S 四名任職者（該公司 amlenetug 為本站追蹤之 MSA 在研藥物，機制正是針對細胞外 α-突觸核蛋白傳播），一併揭露。（2）多倫多大學 Tanz 中心、麻省總醫院與烏普薩拉大學團隊發表於 Brain Pathology：檢驗 MSA 兩個臨床亞型小腦型（MSA-C）與帕金森型（MSA-P）是否屬不同株型，以有限蛋白酶解與構形穩定性測定做生化指紋、並在基因轉殖小鼠做接種傳播比較，結果均未能區分兩者，作者解讀為源自同一株型在不同腦區成形。兩篇合看方向一致而非矛盾——株型差異存在於 MSA 與 PD 之間，不存在於 MSA 內部；若成立，這與現行 MSA 試驗多將兩亞型合併收案的作法前提相符。惟第二篇是「未發現差異」的陰性結果，陰性不等於證明相同，也可能是方法分辨力不足，該研究亦未報告樣本數是否足以排除中小幅度差異。另有一則 Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging 關於結構性 MRI 體積測量鑑別 PSP／PD／MSA 的編輯評論，因屬對他人研究的評論性短文、無原始數據，經評估不予收錄。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢近 7 天內無新試驗、亦無狀態變動：窗內更新的 MSA 相關筆為 Teva TEV-56286 延伸試驗（NCT07197866，已在紀錄內），其餘 08/11–08/13 更新者為 DMD、SMA 與前列腺癌試驗，屬「atrophy」字面誤中，逐筆確認適應症後排除。

en.body: Two papers added to the literature radar — published the same day, both on α-synuclein strains, and complementary in what they find. (1) From Copenhagen University Hospital, Roskilde University and the Institut François Jacob in France, in Neurobiology of Disease: α-synuclein fibrils were amplified from MSA and Parkinson's disease brain by protein misfolding cyclic amplification and inoculated into neuronal cultures and mice. MSA-derived fibrils induced more phosphorylated α-synuclein pathology, and significantly more oligodendroglial pathology than PD-derived material, supporting distinct biological properties for the fibrils of the two diseases — consistent with MSA being defined pathologically by the glial cytoplasmic inclusion within oligodendrocytes. This is animal and cell work rather than a patient study; "more potent" refers to seeding capacity in an experimental system and cannot be extrapolated to rate of progression or treatment response. Four authors are employees of H. Lundbeck A/S, whose amlenetug is one of the investigational MSA agents tracked here and whose mechanism targets the spread of extracellular α-synuclein — disclosed accordingly. (2) From the Tanz Centre at the University of Toronto with Massachusetts General Hospital and Uppsala University, in Brain Pathology: a test of whether the two clinical subtypes, cerebellar (MSA-C) and parkinsonian (MSA-P), carry distinct strains, using limited proteolysis and a conformational stability assay for biochemical fingerprinting alongside seeding and progression comparisons in transgenic mice. Neither approach distinguished the two, which the authors read as one strain forming in different brain regions. Together the two papers point the same way rather than conflicting — strain differences lie between MSA and PD, not within MSA — and if that holds it matches the premise behind the prevailing practice of enrolling both subtypes into a single MSA trial. The second paper is nonetheless a negative result: failing to find a difference is not proof of sameness, the methods may lack the resolution for subtler differences, and the study does not report whether the sample could exclude a small or moderate one. A third hit, an editorial in the Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging on structural MRI volumetry for distinguishing PSP, PD and MSA, was considered and excluded as a short commentary on someone else's study carrying no primary data. Today's CT.gov query returned no new MSA trials and no status changes within the past 7 days: the one MSA-related record updated in the window was Teva's TEV-56286 extension study (NCT07197866), already on the platform, while the 11–13 August updates were DMD, SMA and prostate cancer trials — literal 'atrophy' matches, excluded after checking the indication on each.

body: 文獻雷達新增 2 篇、領域焦點新增 1 則。（1）范德堡大學醫學中心與 CND Life Sciences 團隊發表於 Clinical Autonomic Research 的 12 個月縱貫研究：17 名早期 MSA 病人的皮膚切片 α-突觸核蛋白沉積自基線至 12 個月上升，並與姿勢性低血壓與自律神經症狀相關，作者主張皮膚切片可作為侵入性較低的診斷輔助、病程追蹤與試驗分層工具。n=17 且無疾病對照組（未與帕金森病等其他突觸核蛋白病變比較），故無法說明鑑別診斷特異度；作者群含 Alterity Therapeutics 兩名任職者，一併揭露。收錄理由是它與本站追蹤的 α-突觸核蛋白 PET 示蹤劑（MODAG、Synusight）指向同一個缺口——MSA 確診迄今仍須死後病理，而皮膚切片的技術門檻與成本遠低於 PET。（2）土耳其兩校團隊發表於 Diagnostics 的病例對照研究：30 對 30 測定 11 種血清微量元素，MSA 組鋁、銅較高，鐵、鋅較低，自建之金屬負荷指數經年齡性別校正後仍相關。作者自陳為探索性、需在疾病對照與多中心世代驗證——對照組非其他神經退化疾病是關鍵缺口，且複合指數在自身資料上建構會高估分辨力；另需留意本研究量的是血清鐵並發現偏低，與「腦內特定區域鐵沉積」的機轉假說不是同一件事。（3）領域焦點：Alterity ATH434 於 2026/08/12 取得美國專利商標局新核准之物質組成專利（甲磺酸鹽特定結晶型＋治療方法），公司稱保護期延長至至少 2045 年，且該結晶型即 Ph2 所用、將用於規劃中的 Ph3；此為專利事項、非臨床或法規進展，新聞稿未載專利號。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢回傳之相關試驗（Teva TEV-56286 主試驗與延伸、Lundbeck amlenetug MASCOT、Alterity ATH434 開放標籤延伸、MODAG 造影、Synusight SST001、AskBio 前置研究）全部已在平台紀錄內、狀態無變動；其餘為 DMD、SMA、肌少症等「atrophy」字面誤中，逐筆確認適應症後排除。

en.body: Two papers added to the literature radar and one item to the field highlights. (1) A 12-month longitudinal study from Vanderbilt University Medical Center and CND Life Sciences in Clinical Autonomic Research: in 17 people with early-stage MSA, α-synuclein deposition on skin biopsy increased from baseline to 12 months and correlated with orthostatic hypotension and autonomic symptoms, leading the authors to propose skin biopsy as a minimally invasive aid to diagnosis, progression monitoring and trial stratification. With n=17 and no disease-control arm — no comparison against Parkinson's disease or other synucleinopathies — it cannot speak to specificity for differential diagnosis; two authors are employees of Alterity Therapeutics, disclosed here. It is recorded because it addresses the same gap as the α-synuclein PET tracers this site tracks (MODAG, Synusight): definitive diagnosis of MSA still requires post-mortem pathology, and skin biopsy is far cheaper and technically simpler than PET. (2) A case-control study from two Turkish universities in Diagnostics: eleven serum trace elements measured in 30 patients versus 30 controls, with higher aluminium and copper and lower iron and zinc in MSA, and a composite Metal Burden Index that remained associated after adjustment for age and sex. The authors call the work exploratory and state it needs validation in disease-control and multicentre cohorts — the absence of a neurodegenerative comparison group is the decisive gap, and an index derived and evaluated on the same data will overstate its separating power. Note too that this study measures serum iron and finds it low, which is not the same quantity as the regional brain iron deposition that the mechanistic hypothesis concerns. (3) Field highlight: on 12 August 2026 Alterity's ATH434 was granted a new US composition-of-matter patent (a specific crystalline form of the mesylate salt, plus methods of treatment), which the company says extends protection to at least 2045, the form being the one used in Ph2 and intended for the planned Ph3. This is an intellectual-property matter rather than clinical or regulatory progress, and the release gives no patent number. Every MSA-related trial returned by today's CT.gov query (Teva's TEV-56286 main and extension studies, Lundbeck's amlenetug MASCOT, Alterity's ATH434 open-label extension, the MODAG imaging study, Synusight's SST001 and the AskBio pre-gene-therapy study) was already on the platform with no change of status; the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches in DMD, SMA and sarcopenia, excluded after checking the indication on each record.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇：Clinical Neuropathology 一則年輕發病帕金森症候群的臨床病理不一致個案——病人生前被診斷為神經傳導物質合成障礙（一類多屬可治療的遺傳性代謝疾病），死後病理才確認實為 MSA。單一個案報告，不能推論誤診發生率；收錄理由是它與前一日收錄的德文綜述指向同一個結構性限制：MSA 確診至今仍只能靠死後病理，而在非典型年齡層，MSA 可能完全不在臨床鑑別診斷的視野內。此類誤診方向對疾病修飾療法的意義在於，部分病人在仍可介入的早期階段從未被納入試驗族群。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢回傳的相關試驗（Teva TEV-56286 主試驗與延伸試驗、Lundbeck amlenetug MASCOT、Alterity ATH434 法國開放標籤延伸、MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 造影、Synusight SST001、AskBio 前置研究）全部已在平台紀錄內、狀態無變動；其餘回傳為 risdiplam、salanersen 等脊髓性肌肉萎縮症，以及肌少症、原發性纖毛不動症等「atrophy」字面誤中，逐筆確認適應症後排除。產業新聞掃描：Alterity ATH434 的 FDA End-of-Phase-2 註冊路徑（2026/07/07）與 Lundbeck MASCOT 完成隨機分派（2026/03/12 公告，較原訂提前）均為平台既已記錄的事實，本次未見近 7 天內的新事實。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar: a clinicopathologic mismatch in young-onset parkinsonism, reported in Clinical Neuropathology — the patient was diagnosed during life with a neurotransmitter synthesis disorder, a class of largely treatable inherited metabolic conditions, and only post-mortem pathology established the disease was MSA. It is a single case report and says nothing about how often this happens; it is included because it points at the same structural limitation as the German-language review added the previous day: definitive diagnosis of MSA still requires autopsy, and in an atypical age group MSA may fall entirely outside the clinical differential. For disease-modifying therapy, a miss in this direction means some patients are never entered into the trial population while intervention is still possible. Every MSA-related trial returned by today's CT.gov query (Teva's TEV-56286 main and extension studies, Lundbeck's amlenetug MASCOT, Alterity's French open-label extension of ATH434, the MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 imaging study, Synusight's SST001 and the AskBio pre-gene-therapy study) was already on the platform with no change of status; the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches — spinal muscular atrophy studies such as risdiplam and salanersen, plus sarcopenia and primary ciliary dyskinesia — excluded after checking the indication on each record. On the industry news side, Alterity's FDA End-of-Phase-2 registrational pathway for ATH434 (2026/07/07) and Lundbeck's completion of randomisation in MASCOT (announced 2026/03/12, ahead of plan) are both facts the platform already records; no new facts within the past 7 days were found.

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar: a review of MSA from the Department of Neurology at LMU Klinikum, Munich, published in Fortschritte der Neurologie-Psychiatrie (in German, online ahead of print). It sets out the current consensus — MSA is a rare and rapidly progressive member of the atypical parkinsonian syndromes, presenting with parkinsonism, cerebellar ataxia and autonomic dysfunction, driven pathologically by misfolded α-synuclein in oligodendrocytes causing multisystem degeneration; diagnosis follows the MDS criteria supported by MRI, while definitive confirmation remains post-mortem only; and there are no disease-modifying treatments, so management is symptomatic and multidisciplinary. The authors name biomarker development and interventions against α-synuclein aggregation and neuroinflammation as research priorities. It is a review and contains no new data; it is included as a citable statement of the current criteria, and because the limitation it identifies — diagnosis confirmed only at autopsy — is exactly what several imaging and fluid-biomarker efforts tracked here are trying to solve, among them the MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 imaging study (NCT07640542). Every MSA-related trial returned by CT.gov today (two Teva TEV-56286 studies, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Alterity's French open-label extension of ATH434, the MODAG imaging study, the AskBio pre-gene-therapy study and others) was already on the platform with no change of status, so nothing was added. The remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches from spinal muscular atrophy and sarcopenia studies such as risdiplam and salanersen, excluded after checking each record. The industry news sweep (Alterity ATH434, Lundbeck amlenetug, Teva TEV-56286, Ono ONO-2808, Tiziana foralumab, Ionis ION464) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days.

en.body: *This is a combined 07–08 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 07 August (nothing was published that day) and has been backfilled here. One paper added to the literature radar: a retrospective cohort study from Tokyo Metropolitan Neurological Hospital, published in Movement Disorders Clinical Practice, analysing tracheostomy-free survival in 215 patients with MSA, with mean survival of 3.3 years (SD 2.0). Multivariate analysis identified three independent risk factors: a lower prognostic nutritional index (PNI) (HR 2.12, p = 0.018), a greater decline in BMI (HR 2.90, p < 0.001) and a higher UMSARS Part I item 2 swallowing score (HR 1.59, p = 0.014), leading the authors to conclude that nutritional decline predicts shorter survival independently of the severity of dysphagia. This is a retrospective observational study and establishes association and prediction rather than showing that nutritional support extends survival; its field relevance is that PNI and BMI change come from routine bloods and body weight, far cheaper to obtain than imaging or fluid biomarkers, making them candidate covariates for stratification and survival analysis in trials. Two MSA-related CT.gov updates appeared across the two days: Teva's TEV-56286 (emrusolmin) Ph2 extension study NCT07197866 refreshed its record on 07 August, still recruiting and consistent with what the platform already holds, so no change was needed; and a Vanderbilt study of midodrine versus abdominal compression on cardiovascular risk markers in autonomic failure (NCT04620382) moved to "completed" — a mechanistic study of symptomatic management rather than a disease-modifying therapy, so not recorded. The remainder were literal 'atrophy' matches such as risdiplam in spinal muscular atrophy. The industry news sweep (Alterity ATH434, Lundbeck amlenetug, Teva TEV-56286, Ono ONO-2808, Tiziana foralumab, Ionis ION464) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇：四川大學華西醫院發表於 The Journals of Gerontology Series A 的兩年前瞻世代研究，收案 144 名早期 MSA 病人並依 MSA 專屬 MRI 標記分為影像陽性／陰性兩組，以 UMSARS 總分追蹤；影像陽性組在整體 MSA 與帕金森亞型的惡化速率顯著較快（p = 0.002、p = 0.020），校正年齡、性別與基線病程後於第 1、2 年皆為顯著預測因子。惟 144 人中僅 73 人完成兩年追蹤，且摘要未列出構成「影像陽性」的個別標記與閾值。CT.gov 當日更新中，MSA 相關者僅一筆美國 NINDS 慢性自律神經衰竭實驗室評估研究轉為「已完成」（觀察性研究，非療法，依準則不予收錄）；其餘為 risdiplam 等脊髓性肌肉萎縮症的「atrophy」字面誤中。產業新聞掃描（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Teva TEV-56286、Ono ONO-2808、Ionis ION464）未見近 7 天內的新事實。另本日將頁首「本週新增」KPI 依 git 紀錄逐筆核算為 6 筆，數字變動屬口徑校正。⚠️ 發布備註：本日內容推送後，GitHub Pages 連續兩次建置失敗（13:26、14:43 UTC，每次跑滿約 10 分鐘後逾時；對照 08/05 正常建置僅需 40 秒），姊妹站 SCA-IQ 同時段亦三次失敗，故本日更新上線時間延後。已查證全部資料檔編碼與 JSON 格式皆正常、GitHub 官方狀態頁顯示 Pages 服務正常，判斷為建置管線側問題而非內容錯誤。您能讀到本則即表示建置已恢復。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar: a two-year prospective cohort study from West China Hospital, Sichuan University, published in The Journals of Gerontology Series A, which enrolled 144 patients with early MSA, split them into MRI-positive and MRI-negative groups on MSA-specific imaging markers and followed them on the UMSARS total score. The MRI-positive group progressed significantly faster, both for MSA overall and for the parkinsonian subtype (p = 0.002 and p = 0.020), and MRI-positive status remained a significant predictor at both the 1- and 2-year visits after adjustment for age, sex and baseline disease duration. Only 73 of the 144 patients completed two years of follow-up, however, and the abstract does not specify which individual markers and thresholds define "MRI-positive". Among today's CT.gov updates the sole MSA-related record was a US NINDS laboratory evaluation of chronic autonomic failure moving to "completed" — an observational study rather than a therapeutic, so not recorded — with the remainder literal 'atrophy' matches such as risdiplam in spinal muscular atrophy. The industry news sweep (Alterity ATH434, Lundbeck amlenetug, Teva TEV-56286, Ono ONO-2808, Ionis ION464) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days. The header "new this week" KPI was also recounted item by item from the git history today, giving 6; the change reflects the counting basis, not a change in activity. ⚠️ Publishing note: after today's content was pushed, the GitHub Pages build failed twice in a row (13:26 and 14:43 UTC, each running about 10 minutes before timing out, against 40 seconds for a normal build on 05 August), and the sister site SCA-IQ failed three times over the same period, so today's update went live later than usual.
